note: PATCH /campaigns/{id}/groups/{group_id}: a rename, and only that. The same name again changes nothing and answers 200. Removal is POST .../remove, is permanent, and has no archive (I-2).

valid.name: a rename trimmed as the client trims

invalid.name: no name
invalid.why: a rename is the only change a patch makes

invalid.name: a null name
invalid.why: a group always has a name

invalid.name: a lone surrogate in the name
invalid.why: JSON allows the escape; UTF-8 does not. Refused on both sides, so it is a 422

invalid.name: an archive flag
invalid.why: removing a group is its own route and cannot be undone; there is no archive (I-2)

invalid.name: a newer schema_version
invalid.why: the version this contract speaks is 1
